content.summary: The inspected replay entry point, exact-column controls and staged dependencies support their stated conditional assurance. No new local proof defect emerged from these bounded checks. The H27 correction appropriately exposes an essential external provenance limitation; neither a fresh leaf nor local coverage re-establishes H27.

findings.statement: Exact coefficient replay retains the shared necessary-model builder and imported mathematical premises.
findings.disposition: The wrapper, evaluator and manuscript Section 7 state this boundary. Tested rejection controls and complete column arithmetic strengthen implementation evidence without proving every family-to-row implication.

findings.statement: A successful conditional leaf does not establish complete branch coverage or justify its forbidden traces.
findings.disposition: The separate stage checker requires earlier antecedents, distinct proper-three/full-four facts and literal marker scope. The inspected fresh leaf has 68 distinct earlier antecedents; no whole-branch replay was performed in this round.

findings.statement: H27 remains indispensable and its source-to-historical-run relationship has not been independently authenticated here.
findings.disposition: The new main-text paragraph and superseding addendum accurately separate the README claim from visible script operations. The gap concerns assurance of an explicit imported theorem; this inspection establishes neither a counterexample nor an independent proof. The current argument is not robust to replacing 27 by 28.

revisions.action: Inspected the real wrapper/evaluator and exercised bounded source-pin and exact-arithmetic rejection controls.
revisions.result: Retain the shared-builder qualification; selected controls pass but do not establish all model-row mathematics.

revisions.action: Inspected stage-checker dependency rules and the fresh leaf's actual 68 antecedents.
revisions.result: The tested source-to-result chain separates leaf validity from coverage and forbids unsupported trace deletion; arbitrary-support bridges remain separate ordinary obligations.

checks.scope: Real replay entry point and source/version binding
checks.method: Read replay_d17_leaf_fresh.py and replay_degree17_full_v9.py:1253-1467; checked the fresh receipt and ran standard-library early rejection controls.
checks.observation: The wrapper pins the evaluator and uses exclusive output creation. Actual tests rejected an occupied destination, changed evaluator and unsupported producer digest before model construction. The evaluator requires an allowed source/phase-one pairing, preserves original model metadata, binds imported files and compares rebuilt literal premises. All 47 receipt-bound dependency/source/original/adapter/input files matched. The saved leaf records 24727 columns and G=-406255021 at scale 10000000000. These are integrity/scalar checks, not a fresh leaf replay. Controls and bindings are preserved under review67/checks/round05/methodologist/.

checks.scope: All-column box correction and strict exclusion
checks.method: Read replay_degree17_full_v9.py:1468-1590; executed its unchanged extracted arithmetic block on synthetic CSR data, independently enumerating a small integer box.
checks.observation: For x<=51y, x in [0,51], y in [0,1], all 104 points give optimum 51. The extracted evaluator includes the selector correction 51 and returns strict_exclusion=false. It rejected omitted correction, false strictness, zero scale, out-of-range row and Boolean weight. An explicit zero-objective impossible box gave G=-1<0. Source inspection also confirms full matrix dimensions, integral finite entries/boxes and all q columns are checked. These controls cover the arithmetic block, not every matrix-building path. See checks/round05/methodologist/check_controls.py and results.json.

checks.scope: Conditional leaf to acyclic staged result
checks.method: Read check_d17_stage_plan_v9.py:225-460 and inspected the actual four-E4_56 node in P9-Q8-complete-plan-v9.json.
checks.observation: The 68 uses are distinct and strictly earlier. Source checks reject unknown producer/replayer versions, unsupported extra-member splits, unproved forbidden proper traces and unsupported empty-Z/full-core premises. They compare literal geometry, actual-marker metadata, input/premise hashes and exact scalar fields, require strict_exclusion=true, and demand version-specific triangle/B4/H27/complement/copy validations. Thus arithmetic PASS alone cannot close this leaf in the plan. Inspection does not independently recompute all 94 leaves or every q vector.

checks.method: Read manuscript Section 2, the superseding addendum, and retained primary README/script blobs; independently checked the cyclic A3 coefficient identity.
checks.observation: The visible script extracts three archives, checks two assembled frontier hashes, invokes run-record verification and small controls; it does not explicitly compare the three compressed archive hashes claimed by the README. The manuscript now reports this and the unavailable provenance pointer without claiming historical authentication. Algebra gives sum(e)=8h-204 and a_i=3h-68-e_i-e_(i+3)-e_(i+5)>=136-5h: h=27 gives neighbourhood 41/fibre lower bound 1, whereas h=28 gives 40/-4. This validates the stated limitation, not the external target-28 exhaustion.
